text.tspan: HA control plane: 3 nodes behind a load balancer
API servers are active-active. Scheduler and controller-manager are active-passive: one leader, chosen by a Lease.
etcd needs a majority: 3 nodes survive 1 failure. On EKS AWS runs all of this across 3 AZs; you never see it.
